review_evidence: HexLLLMathlib/Reduction.lean proves that native and selected LLL outputs are reduced, preserve lattice membership, preserve independence, and satisfy short-vector guarantees.
HexLLLMathlib/Checker.lean proves soundness theorems lllReduced_sound and lllReducedCheck_sound.
State, ShortVector, IntegerLattice, Interval, and ReductionInvariant modules connect executable state and certificates to Mathlib mathematical structures.
summary: Retain hex-lll-mathlib as the substantive Mathlib bridge proving correctness properties of the executable LLL implementation.
